verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Docs as a first-party product (clickup-docs-16). Docs sit in the same workspace as tasks, Lists and Folders, so they are searchable together (clickup-docs-36, clickup-docs-38) and AI can work across tasks and docs (clickup-docs-20, clickup-docs-40), with Figma embeds supported inside Docs (clickup-intdir-5). That supports the core of the story, but the evidence is mostly feature labels and indirect mentions. missing for 10: detailed docs on creating, nesting and organizing Docs, evidence of real-time collaborative editing and sharing permissions, explicit linking of docs to tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
